Content:
I've seen a lot of talk already in these comments about the leftists celebrating Charlie Kirks death.

As a leftist, I completely agree that is wrong. However, this seems to be suggesting that this is only an issue on the left side, which simply could not be further from the truth. The right have celebrated and made fun of all kinds of attacks and murders of people on the left. 

I should also mention, that pretty much everybody on the left who has mocked Charlie Kirks death are not politicians. Almost all of them are random civilians. If you look at social media posts from high profile left wing politicians on the death of Charlie Kirk. Almost all of them are paying their respects. For example, Obama, Biden, Bill Clinton, Hillary Clinton, Bernie Sanders etc, all posted their respects to him. By contrast, high profile right wing personalities and politicians, have celebrated and made fun of political attacks against the left.

If you want evidence, I will happily give you some examples.

1) 3 months ago in June, after Democrat politician Melissa Hortman was murdered. Utah Senator Mike Lee posted on Twitter "this is what happens when marxists don't get their way".

2) Also after the Melissa Hortman attack. Right wing personality Laura Loomer, promoted a baseless conspiracy theory that the shooter in that case was hired by former Democrat vice-president candidate Tim Waltz.

3) After Nancy Pelosi's house was broken into and her 82 year old husband Paul Pelosi was attacked with a hammer, requiring him to need surgery to repair a fractured skull. Arizona politician Kari Lake (who now works in the Trump administration) said "Nancy Pelosi has protection in D.C, apparently her house doesn't"

4) Also after the attack on Paul Pelosi, Donald Trump Jr. posted a photo on twitter of a hammer and a pair of underwear. Captioning it "Paul Pelosi's Halloween costume".

In fact, in relation to that Paul Pelosi incident CHARLIE KIRK HIMSELF said about the attacker "Why has he not been bailed out? By the way, if some amazing patriot out there wants to be a hero, they should go and bail this guy out". That's part of the reason why some people are mocking Charlie Kirk, because he mocked victims of other political attacks.

Even the leader and figure head of the Republican party, Donald Trump, has made comments which promote violence against the left. For example at a rally one time after the Paul Pelosi attack he said "how's Paul doing by the way" to a response of laughter from the crowd. He once reposted a photo showing Joe Biden locked up in the back of a truck. He also once posted an AI photo of himself holding a hammer to Alvin Bragg's head.

So please, please. Do not try to act as though the celebration and mocking of political attacks only happens on the left. I am happy to admit that it does happen on the left and is disgusting. But it also happens just as much on the right.

Where the 2 sides actually differ, is when it comes to high profile figures and politicians. It's very rare that you see someone high profile on the left, mocking the death of Charlie Kirk. Whereas numerous high profile figures on the right, including Charlie Kirk, social media personalities, politicians, all the way up to the sitting president, have mocked and made light of political attacks against the left.

And as much as I do agree that people on the left celebrating Charlie Kirk's death are disgusting. You have to acknowledge that a lot of those posts are in response to what the right have been doing over the past few years.

Personally I blame Trump. You would never hear any other presidential candidate (left or right wing) says the kind of things he's said. Obama, Biden, Romney, McCain, Bush, Clinton. Not one of them has EVER mocked the victim of a political attack. Not one of them has EVER posted a photo of their opponent being locked up in a truck. Not one of them has EVER posted an AI generated image of themselves holding a hammer to the head of a prosecutor

To give you another example, this is a direct quote which Trump said about Liz Cheney last year "She’s a radical war hawk. Let’s put her with a rifle standing there, with nine barrels shooting at her, OK? Let’s see how she feels about it when the guns are trained on her face"

Donald Trump brought all of this into our politics. Yes there are people on the left who react to him and say bad things in response. But Trump has made it acceptable on the right wing for people to celebrate political attacks. Whether they are civilians, social media personalities, politicians or the president himself.

And the crazy thing is, NOBODY on the right ever calls Trump out on it! I can absolutely guarantee you, that if Barack Obama called for "guns to be trained on the face" of a right wing politician. It would be front page news for months. And nearly every Democrat politician would criticize him for saying it.

Trump on the other hand. Says this kind of thing, and barely anyone notices. Because he says those things so often, we are numb to it. But even so, it's disgusting that he can say those things. And not one single right wing politician, social media personality or even voter, will criticize him for it.
